About Us

Engineering Expertise for Complex Projects
Established in 2020, PT Reka Daya Kencana is an engineering, heavy-lift, and construction company specializing in integrated solutions. If you can imagine it, we can make it happen. No matter the level of difficulty, our team will create safe and proven engineering solutions.
Learn More About Us

Services

Integrated Services for Complex Industrial Projects
Engineering, procurement, construction, and heavy lifting services to meet a wide range of industrial project needs.
Engineering
Planning, technical studies, and engineering design to ensure the appropriate technical approach for each project.
Procurement
Procurement of project equipment and materials to ensure the smooth progress of construction.
Construction
Construction of various industrial and infrastructure facilities.
Heavy Lifting Project
Heavy-lift and transportation solutions for the installation of industrial equipment and large-scale structures.
